summary: V6.25.48 — Battlemap right-sidebar overhaul verified end-to-end. Backend 6/6 PASS: 3/3 existing test_v62548_battlemap_sidebar.py (token roundtrip / vitals empty / vitals linked-character) + 3 NEW test_v62548_battlemap_supplemental.py (vitals 403 for non-member outsider, all 8 marker_type curated palette round-trips, POST-as-upsert PATCH + DELETE token CRUD regression). Frontend smoke (admin GM on production preview pod, session 5cab71abc10b4307b6d8a905be53dd3b, viewport 1440×900, post 8.5s settle): every required testid present (battlemap-shell, sidebar, view-controls, snap-toggle, zoom-in/out/reset/readout, pc-roster, 23× roster-row-{cid}, 23× spawn-pc-{cid}, marker-palette, all 8 marker tokens door/trap/treasure/chest/stairs/portal/ladder/note, legend). Marker placement: click marker-trap → placement-banner reads 'Click canvas to drop · Trap' → canvas click fires POST /map/tokens with kind=marker marker_type=trap color=#f87171 and a map-token-{id} with data-token-kind=marker is rendered. PC spawn: click spawn-pc-Eli (35b9746b…) → banner 'Click canvas to drop · Eli' → canvas drop persists, Eli's spawn button flips to '✓' (one-shot per session). Zoom: 100% → +25% → reset back to 100%. Snap-toggle clicks cleanly. Atlas-pin section absent for this campaign (0 pins) — graceful no-render, per spec.

issues: battlemap-snap-toggle does not expose aria-pressed; the button visually toggles state but assistive tech cannot read its pressed state. Minor a11y nit, not blocking.

After a PC token is spawned the spawn-pc-{cid} button changes its text to '✓' but the HTML disabled attribute is NOT applied. Functionally the post-spawn click is a no-op (idempotent on the server) but adding `disabled` would prevent accidental re-arming of the placement banner and improve screen-reader semantics.

Banner text concatenates the label and the inline 'cancel' button without a separator → page.text_content() reads 'Click canvas to drop · Trapcancel'. Insert a space / visible divider so it reads 'Click canvas to drop · Trap   cancel'.

action_items: OPTIONAL P3 a11y polish: add aria-pressed to battlemap-snap-toggle, add `disabled` attr to spawn-pc-{cid} after spawn, add a separating space (or non-text gap) between marker name and 'cancel' inside battlemap-placement-banner.

P1/P2 work in original PRD (auto-fill HP/EP rings from sheet damage, atlas-pin → battlemap link) is NOT directly testable on this campaign (no live HP damage recorded, 0 atlas pins). Vitals endpoint already wired; verify on a campaign with damage + pins, or pre-seed both before next regression.
critical_code_review_comments: battlemap.py TokenIn correctly accepts the new optional fields (kind/marker_type/ep_pct/initiative_order/atlas_node_id/tooltip/locked) and the upsert endpoint round-trips them; defaults applied server-side (ep_pct=100, initiative_order=None). Clean.

POST /sessions/{sid}/map/tokens doubles as both create and patch (id-in-body upsert). There is no dedicated PATCH/PUT route — clients must resend the full payload to update. Functional but inconsistent with the writer_tools.py pattern; consider PATCH /map/tokens/{tid} with optional fields if reuse outside Battlemap is expected.
_pc_vitals_for() correctly returns 100% defaults when no live HP is recorded — by design per spec. Endpoint enforces _is_member() and returns 403 for outsiders (verified).
Battlemap.jsx — marker tokens are excluded from LoS occlusion, as documented. PendingPlacement state is reset on cancel and on successful POST; placement banner correctly disappears.
Frontend POST body confirmed in network capture: {x,y,size,hp_pct,ep_pct,status,color,label,kind,marker_type,character_id,atlas_node_id,tooltip} — all schema-aligned with TokenIn.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_v62548_battlemap_supplemental.py (new — 3 supplemental backend tests: vitals 403 non-member, all 8 marker palette types, POST-upsert + DELETE regression)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required testids present, marker + PC spawn + zoom + snap flows verified live)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests: ephemeral campaigns 'BattlemapTest-*' / 'BMS-*' all DELETE'd in finally blocks. Ephemeral outsider users 'v62548-outsider-*@example.com' (no user-delete API, harmless). Frontend smoke: spawned 1 trap-marker token and 1 Eli PC token on shared session 5cab71abc10b4307b6d8a905be53dd3b — left in place since spawn-once-per-session is the documented behaviour; next agent can DELETE if needed via DELETE /api/sessions/{sid}/map/tokens/{tid}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V6.25.48 P0 fully green: backend 6/6 + frontend smoke all required testids confirmed via browser automation on production preview pod. Important quirks: (1) /api/auth/register rejects @tablegnostic.test — use @example.com for synthetic outsiders. (2) There is NO PATCH /map/tokens — the POST endpoint is upsert; send {id, ...patch} in body. (3) emails like *.test are blocked by the email validator. (4) Session 5cab71... now has 1 leftover trap-marker + 1 Eli PC token from this run; budget for an extra token or DELETE if your test requires a clean map. (5) Atlas-pin sidebar section testid is battlemap-sidebar-atlas-pins — confirmed absent when campaign has 0 pins (graceful). (6) battlemap-snap-toggle lacks aria-pressed; check via .className 'on/off' suffix or button text instead.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures detected. All 6 backend tests pass, all required frontend testids render, marker-drop and PC-spawn flows persist via POST /map/tokens with correct kind/marker_type payload, vitals polling pulls hp_pct/ep_pct=100% defaults as designed.
